in_marathi.name: Sivaranjani
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess of Gratitude and Love
in_marathi.long_meaning: Sivaranjani हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Sivaranjani is derived from the Tamil language and is a combination of two words - Siva (God) and Ranjanam (one who pleases or delights). The name signifies the Goddess who delights and pleases the God Shiva. It is a name that evokes feelings of love, gratitude, and victory.
